title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6 Release
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.6 is now available.
Added built-in SA-MP Chatlog Viewer & Searcher tab with real-time text query and instant keyword filtering.
Integrated dedicated chatlog category filters for PMs, Radio/Dept chatter, Local actions, and Admin/Server alerts.
Added one-click Copy Filtered Lines, Open Folder in Explorer, and Auto-scroll to bottom controls.
Integrated native in-launcher background auto-updater with live progress tracking and automated install.
Added manual Check for Updates button under Settings > About Spynixx Launcher.
